smp-pqc-testkit

Sovereign Mohawk Post-Quantum Test Kit
ML-KEM · ML-DSA · SLH-DSA in pure Rust — validated against NIST's own ACVP reference vectors, not just internal self-consistency.
RUST APACHE-2.0 NIST ACVP-TESTED LEAN 4 VERIFIED
Closest Vector Problem — the hard lattice problem ML-KEM/ML-DSA's security rests on. Given the lattice and a target point, finding the nearest lattice vector is easy in low dimensions, intractable at cryptographic scale — for classical and quantum computers alike.
